title: ICU Clinical Review
summary: This open access book is a focused and comprehensive guide designed to enhance clinical insight and familiarity with common scenarios encountered in ICU exams and real-life cases. The goal is to create a practical, concise resource that highlights the most critical points to help ICU practitioners in both their clinical exams and during their ICU duties. Grounded in evidence, this book contains the most essential ICU clinical trials and references. It consists of chapters covering ICU subspecialties, each addressing the key skills ICU physicians need to master. To ensure accuracy and coverage, the book has been reviewed by experts from various departments, who were assigned to the chapters according to their respective subspecialties. ICU Clinical Review will be a valuable resource for ICU physicians (residents, fellows, specialists, etc.), who can use it as a reference during on-call duties and clinical exams.
